WITH mesh_namespace AS (
  SELECT oid, nspname, nspowner, nspacl
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace
  WHERE nspname = 'falcon_mesh'
), mesh_tables AS (
  SELECT c.*
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c
  JOIN mesh_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p')
), inspected_roles AS (
  SELECT oid, rolname
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles
  WHERE rolname IN ('falcon_mesh_app', 'anon', 'authenticated', 'service_role')
)
SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
  'database', pg_catalog.current_database(),
  'current_user', current_user,
  'server_version', pg_catalog.current_setting('server_version'),
  'catalog', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'namespace', COALESCE((
      SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'nspname', nspname, 'comment', pg_catalog.obj_description(oid, 'pg_namespace')
      )) FROM mesh_namespace
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'tables', COALESCE((
      SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'relname', relname, 'relkind', relkind,
        'relrowsecurity', relrowsecurity, 'relforcerowsecurity', relforcerowsecurity
      ) ORDER BY relname) FROM mesh_tables
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'columns', COALESCE((
      SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'relname', c.relname, 'attname', a.attname,
        'type', pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod),
        'attnotnull', a.attnotnull,
        'default_expression', pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid)
      ) ORDER BY c.relname, a.attnum)
      FROM mesh_tables c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid
      LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum
      WHERE a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'constraints', COALESCE((
      SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'relname', c.relname, 'conname', con.conname, 'contype', con.contype,
        'definition', pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid), 'convalidated', con.convalidated
      ) ORDER BY c.relname, con.conname)
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint con JOIN mesh_tables c ON c.oid = con.conrelid
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'indexes', COALESCE((
      SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'tablename', tablename, 'indexname', indexname, 'indexdef', indexdef
      ) ORDER BY tablename, indexname)
      FROM pg_catalog.pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'falcon_mesh'
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ),
  'schema_owner', (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) FROM mesh_namespace),
  'schema_acl', (SELECT nspacl::text FROM mesh_namespace),
  'index_status', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'tablename', c.relname, 'indexname', i.relname, 'indisunique', x.indisunique,
      'indisvalid', x.indisvalid, 'indisready', x.indisready, 'indislive', x.indislive
    ) ORDER BY c.relname, i.relname)
    FROM mesh_tables c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index x ON x.indrelid = c.oid
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'app_role', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'rolname', rolname, 'rolcanlogin', rolcanlogin, 'rolsuper', rolsuper,
      'rolcreatedb', rolcreatedb, 'rolcreaterole', rolcreaterole,
      'rolreplication', rolreplication, 'rolbypassrls', rolbypassrls, 'rolinherit', rolinherit
    )) FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'falcon_mesh_app'
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'app_memberships', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'granted_role', parent.rolname, 'member', member.rolname, 'grantor', grantor.rolname,
      'admin_option', m.admin_option, 'inherit_option', m.inherit_option, 'set_option', m.set_option
    ) ORDER BY parent.rolname, member.rolname)
    FROM pg_catalog.pg_auth_members m
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles parent ON parent.oid = m.roleid
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles member ON member.oid = m.member
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_roles grantor ON grantor.oid = m.grantor
    WHERE parent.rolname = 'falcon_mesh_app' OR member.rolname = 'falcon_mesh_app'
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'schema_privileges', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'role', r.rolname, 'schema_usage', pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(r.oid, n.oid, 'USAGE'),
      'schema_create', pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(r.oid, n.oid, 'CREATE')
    ) ORDER BY r.rolname)
    FROM inspected_roles r CROSS JOIN mesh_namespace n
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'table_privileges', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'role', r.rolname, 'table_name', c.relname,
      'select', pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'SELECT'),
      'insert', pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'INSERT'),
      'update', pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'UPDATE'),
      'delete', pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'DELETE'),
      'truncate', pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'TRUNCATE'),
      'references', pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'REFERENCES'),
      'trigger', pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'TRIGGER'),
      'maintain', pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, 'MAINTAIN')
    ) ORDER BY r.rolname, c.relname)
    FROM inspected_roles r CROSS JOIN mesh_tables c
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'column_privileges', COALESCE((
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'role', r.rolname, 'table_name', c.relname, 'column_name', a.attname,
      'select', pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, a.attnum, 'SELECT'),
      'insert', pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, a.attnum, 'INSERT'),
      'update', pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, a.attnum, 'UPDATE'),
      'references', pg_catalog.has_column_privilege(r.oid, c.oid, a.attnum, 'REFERENCES')
    ) ORDER BY r.rolname, c.relname, a.attnum)
    FROM inspected_roles r CROSS JOIN mesh_tables c
    JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid
    WHERE a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
  ), '[]'::jsonb),
  'app_database_privileges', (
    SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'connect', pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(oid, pg_catalog.current_database(), 'CONNECT'),
      'create', pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(oid, pg_catalog.current_database(), 'CREATE'),
      'temporary', pg_catalog.has_database_privilege(oid, pg_catalog.current_database(), 'TEMPORARY')
    ) FROM inspected_roles WHERE rolname = 'falcon_mesh_app'
  )
) AS verification;
